# Effect

> > Effect is a TypeScript library for building robust, composable applications with type-safe error handling, dependency injection, and structured concurrency.

Effect provides a comprehensive standard library for TypeScript developers seeking functional programming patterns with practical features like runtime safety, observability, and AI integration. Created by Michael Arnaldi, Effect represents the evolution of fp-ts and brings production-ready tools for enterprise TypeScript applications.

## Key Topics

- TypeScript
- Effect
- functional-programming
- type-safety
- error-handling
- structured-concurrency
- dependency-injection
- generators
- observability

- composability

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://effect.website/docs/getting-started/introduction): Getting started guide: Effect features, navigation, and TypeScript basics
- [Why Effect?](https://effect.website/docs/getting-started/why-effect): Explains Effect's value: type-tracked errors, context, and reliability
- [Installation](https://effect.website/docs/getting-started/installation): Setup guide: Install Effect for Node.js, Deno, Bun, and Vite+React
- [Creating Effects](https://effect.website/docs/getting-started/creating-effects): Guide: Create effects for structured success, failure, and side effects
- [Using Generators](https://effect.website/docs/getting-started/using-generators): Generator syntax guide: async/await-like effectful code with Effect.gen

## Core Concepts

- [Introduction to Effect Schema](https://effect.website/docs/schema/introduction): Schema module guide: Define, validate, and transform TypeScript data
- [Managing Layers](https://effect.website/docs/requirements-management/layers): Layers guide: Dependency graphs and service construction patterns
- [Introduction to Runtime](https://effect.website/docs/runtime): Runtime system guide: Execute effects with Context, FiberRefs, and flags
- [Resource Management](https://effect.website/docs/resource-management/introduction): Resource management: Efficient cleanup and finalization patterns
- [Stream Operations](https://effect.website/docs/stream/operations): Stream operations reference: tap, take, map, and element manipulation
- [Introduction to Sink](https://effect.website/docs/sink/introduction): Sink basics: Stream element consumption, errors, and leftovers

## AI Integration

- [Introduction to Effect AI](https://effect.website/docs/ai/introduction): AI integration guide: Provider-agnostic LLM packages for Effect

## Comparisons & Migration

- [Effect vs Promise](https://effect.website/docs/additional-resources/effect-vs-promise): Comparison: Effect vs Promise for async operations and type safety
